value.rationale: A three-tap log-sum-exp soft maximum is a natural nonlinear smoothing stencil. Its exact nonexpansive design boundary is b²>=ac, and violation has precise amplification 1+2(sqrt(ac)-b)/(sqrt(ac)+b), potentially approaching 3. This quantitatively distinguishes stable from unstable weights for perturbed signals and is independent of temperature and path length; exact nonattainment is an additional structural feature.
